scope: The incoming P16 continuous-positive-complex-Hessian criterion, its arbitrary Hermitian-factor product formula and its non-Dini Hopf-surface product example are independently reconstructed in a 264-line inactive fragment with four proofs. The continuous-coefficient Fredholm extension includes its own contact-set minimum estimate, coefficient-free maximum-principle passage and compact-perturbation argument. Existing support-density bounds and the directional derivative theorem supply the final uniqueness implication. Original P16 remains open.
